fields.Name: T117 - AI Model Detail
fields.Description: Verifies that opening an individual AI model renders its configuration view without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Models section, then click into a model to view its configuration. If a preview appears, use 'Open Full Record' to load the full detail form. Confirm the model detail view renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: An individual AI model's detail/configuration view is displayed
The detail view shows model fields or configuration content
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
